items.source:
Set the name of the field which contains metadata in each time series document. Should not be the id nor timeSeries(String) timeField} nor point to an array or Collection.
Annotated fieldnames will be considered during the mapping process.
items.translation:
设置包含每个时间序列文档元数据的字段名称。该字段不应是 id，也不应是 timeSeries(String) timeField}，且不能指向数组或 Collection。
Annotated fieldnames 将在映射过程中被考虑。

items.source:
Create a new instance of CollectionOptions.TimeSeriesOptions using the given field as its timeField. The one, that contains the date in each time series document.
Annotated fieldnames will be considered during the mapping process.
items.translation:
使用给定的字段作为时间字段创建一个新的CollectionOptions.TimeSeriesOptions实例。该字段包含每个时间序列文档中的日期。
在映射过程中，将考虑Annotated fieldnames。

items.source: Select the GranularityDefinition parameter to define how data in the time series collection is organized.
items.translation: 选择GranularityDefinition参数，以定义时间序列集合中数据的组织方式。

items.source: Create a new instance of CollectionOptions.TimeSeriesOptions using the given field as its timeField.
items.translation: 使用给定字段作为时间字段，创建一个新的CollectionOptions.TimeSeriesOptions实例。

items.source: Select the GranularityDefinition parameter to define how data in the time series collection is organized. Select one that is closest to the time span between incoming measurements.
items.translation: 选择 GranularityDefinition 参数来定义时间序列集合中数据的组织方式。 请选择一个最接近于传入测量值之间时间跨度的选项。

items.source: Select the time between timestamps in the same bucket to define how data in the time series collection is organized. Cannot be used in conjunction with granularity(GranularityDefinition).
items.translation: 选择同一桶内的时间戳之间的时间间隔，以定义时间序列集合中数据的组织方式。不能与granularity(GranularityDefinition)一起使用。
